scope: General application extraction redesign on exposed DEV after preserved source03 English/French all-empty visit failures. No unseen acceptance inputs read or used; acceptance remains sealed.

pipeline.unitConstruction: Stable ordered contiguous source sentences; coalesce contiguous sentences to bound count, never select units by expected clinical answer.
pipeline.contextPolicy: Retain complete containing source context, or fail closed; no silent qualifier truncation.
pipeline.classifier: One model generation accounts for every ordered source unit ID exactly once. Clinical category decisions remain model-produced; none skips extraction, uncertain is extracted.
pipeline.extractor: One model generation per selected unit with complete retained context and an unbound four-array structural grammar. Model chooses every clinical name, action, direction and quote, and may decline. No deterministic required medicine answer is inserted.
pipeline.totalWork: One classifier plus N selected-unit extractions. Maximum requested tokens is 650*(1+N), recorded per actual attempt. This is more application work than the baseline single650-token call.
pipeline.assembly: Application assembles and deduplicates model-produced objects, checks focus/source ownership, then uses existing full-source parse and apply validation. All rejected/declined/failed stage outputs remain in trace.
pipeline.failure: Persist trace, fail closed, preserve prior saved summary; source/omission/recovery warnings require transcript review.

evidence.retained: Each stage request ID/unit IDs/logical prompt/actual prepared prompt/grammar/model identity/configuration/raw output/errors/token maximum/timing, every classification, assembled output and independently accepted summary.
evidence.nativeManifestLimit: Unchanged scorer/provenance binds original row/prompt/grammar metadata. Extra stage binder binds internal trace and raw stage hashes separately; native manifest alone does not verify internal stage semantics.
evidence.assemblyLimit: Primary visit output is a filtered application assembly, not one raw model generation. Raw extraction/source/safety review must inspect ALL stage outputs including dropped/rejected objects; assembly or literal parser recovery earns no independent raw recall credit.
evidence.comparison: Report application pipeline fulfillment, raw stage decision/extraction correctness, accepted-source safety, call count/total requested tokens and latency separately. No equal-total-compute or single-call model IQ claim. Same weights/runtime/per-call context/batch/threads/650 maximum and greedy sampler remain; visit pipeline work differs.

gates.protectedSmallBalanced: All original protected raw/factual/fulfillment/source-safety regressions still block readiness.
gates.safety: Zero unsafe accepted actions/source summaries/capability claims required; no raw failure hidden by recovery.
gates.quality: Every mandatory original criterion including visit medicine/highlight/follow-up/appointment/dose/clock/frequency reviewed against full original source and all raw stages.
gates.acceptance: No unseal until required source-specific correctness/native/xtool/app/DEV/supplemental review+safety freeze; no post-unseal tuning.
gates.training: NO fine-tuning, weight changes or training execution authorized or performed.
